title: TEMPER: Testing Emotional Perturbation in Quantitative Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2604.07801v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are trained and evaluated on quantitative reasoning tasks written in clean, emotionally neutral language. However, real-world queries are often wrapped in frustration, urgency or enthusiasm. Does emotional framing alone degrade reasoning when all numerical content is preserved? To investigate this, a controlled emotion translation framework is developed that rewrites problems into emotional variants while preserving all quantities and relationships. Using this framework, Temper-5400 (5,400 semantically verified emotion-neutral pairs) is constructed across GSM8K, MultiArith, and ARC-Challenge, and evaluated on eighteen models (1B to frontier scale). Two core results emerge: First, emotional framing reduces accuracy by 2-10 percentage points even though all numerical content is preserved. Second, neutralizing emotional variants recovers most of the lost performance, showing both that the degradation is tied

translated_title: TEMPER：定量推理中的情绪扰动测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.07801v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大型语言模型在训练和评估时，使用的定量推理任务通常以干净、情感中立的语言书写。然而，现实世界中的查询往往包裹着挫败感、紧迫感或热情。当所有数值内容保持不变时，仅情感框架本身是否会降低推理能力？为了探究这一点，我们开发了一个受控的情感翻译框架，该框架在保留所有数量和关系的同时，将问题改写为情感变体。利用此框架，我们构建了Temper-5400（5,400个经过语义验证的情感中立对），覆盖GSM8K、MultiArith和ARC-Challenge数据集，并在十八个模型（从10亿参数到前沿规模）上进行了评估。出现了两个核心结果：首先，即使所有数值内容保持不变，情感框架也会使准确率降低2至10个百分点。其次，中和情感变体可以恢复大部分性能损失，表明性能下降与情感框架紧密相关。
tldr: 该论文通过构建Temper-5400数据集，证明了即使在数值内容完全保留的情况下，情感化表述也会显著降低大型语言模型的定量推理准确率，而中和情感可恢复大部分性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Temper-5400 and demonstrates that emotional framing significantly degrades large language models' quantitative reasoning accuracy even when all numerical content is preserved, with neutralization recovering most lost performance.
